why_it_moved.text: CTR is up 2.4% and Clicks per User up 2.2%, but Successful Search Rate and Long Click Rate are flat. Likely the ranker surfaces more attractive, not more relevant, results.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Snippet length is the same in both arms, so the extra clicks come from ranking, not presentation.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Reformulation Rate is down 0.9% while Abandonment Rate and Queries per User are flat. One of many secondaries, so treat it as a lead only.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A long-click rate that rises with the extra clicks would point to real satisfaction, but the flat success rate already rules out the 0.50% bar.
A pre-exposure comparison would clear the pre-period check that could not run.
